Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation : Sounds and Word Stress
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation : Sounds and Word Stress, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to articulate sounds correctly? 2. How can we improve our pronunciation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation : Sounds and Word Stress together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: A learner selects digital technology relevant to the tasks while watching and listening to audio visual

recordings.

● Communication and collaboration: A learner speaks clearly and effectively while articulating the sounds correctly.

Collaborations: A learner actively participates when recording the target sounds in groups.

Values:
Unity: A learner works together to record sounds and words

Link to other subjects:

Kiswahili and other languages require correct articulation of sounds.

Braille cards, Braille machine , Braille paper, Audio-visual clips
